notes:
Summary: Octant Ink Labs builds a low-latency VS Code copilot extension used by internal and external developer teams (desktop & remote). They want streaming token-by-token completions and inline suggestions with near-instant updates inside the editor. Key asks: model/version pinning, predictable rate limits for extension clients, and transparent per-token cost/latency tradeoffs.

Recent timeline and activity:
- 2026-02-11: Intro discovery call (Jordan + Maya). Product lead: Aaron Solis. Heard: "inline suggestions must feel instant — <30ms ideally for median on dev machines". Discussed workload shape: many short prefix completions, ~120 concurrent users peak, 20k DAU on beta. (Fireflies ff_2026-02-11_0217)
- 2026-02-25: Technical deep-dive w/ infra + security. Ran through extension auth flows, token refresh cadence, and throttling patterns. SE asked about streaming SLOs and fallback to quantized variants. (ff_2026-02-25_1410)
- 2026-03-05: POC kickoff — extension integrated with Redwood sandbox API, basic streaming enabled, smoke tests for latency/ordering. First POC milestone: demonstrate <50ms median for inline suggestions across 85% of synthetic traces.

Requirements / notes from SE calls:
- Latency: target 20–50ms median for inline token delivery on hosted infra; 95th pct <200ms.
- Throughput: peak 120 concurrent streaming sessions, average request size ~8–30 tokens per suggestion.
- Model pinning: must be able to pin a specific model + checksum per release of the extension; rollbacks required for 24–48h canary windows.
- Streaming behavior: prefer server-initiated chunked SSE/HTTP2 streaming; need deterministic partial outputs for deterministic UI merging.
- Rate limits: extension will be distributed to customers; need per-agent API keys + per-key rate shaping and clear guidance on backoff. Concern: bursty traffic when hundreds of engineers use the extension at start of day.
- Cost: high sensitivity — exploring Optimize suggestions for batching/caching and cheaper quantized variants for lower-priority suggestions.
- Security: SSO (SAML) required for company-wide rollout; audit logs + key rotation + KMS integration mandatory. Data residency: US-EAST for now.

POC plan / milestones:
- Week 1: streaming integration + latency baseline (done).
- Week 2: instrument KV/prefix caching to check cost impact.
- Week 3: implement model pin and canary rollout toggles in extension staging.
- Week 4: security review + SAML test with their IdP.

Quotes / direct paraphrases:
- Aaron (product): "We need the UI to never feel jittery — streaming must be smooth and resumable if network blips."
- Eng lead: "If costs spike we need automated fallback to a quantized 8-bit variant with minimal behavior change."

Open questions / blockers:
- Security team wants SAML SOW and SOC2 evidence before dedicated pilot access.
- Clarify exact billing model for aggregated extension tokens vs. per-session metering.
- Need explicit docs for rate-limit headers and recommended client-side backoff.

Next immediate step: Jordan to send dedicated pilot cluster request + SAML SOW; Maya to deliver expected latency simulation harness to Octant by 2026-03-12.
